rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something ordinary, common, or unexceptional.

example.english: This is an ordinary breakfast for an office worker.
example.traditional: 呢個係普通嘅上班族早餐。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 hai6 pou2 tung1 ge3 soeng6 baan1 zuk6 zou2 caan1

rows.note: Use this for an unremarkable person or life with no special qualities, especially in a somewhat elevated style.

example.english: He lived an ordinary and peaceful life.
example.traditional: 佢過住平凡而安穩嘅一生。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gwo3 zyu6 ping4 faan4 ji4 on1 wan2 ge3 jat1 sang1

rows.note: Use this when an ordinary life or experience is uneventful or somewhat dull.

example.english: Our life after marriage has always been ordinary and uneventful.
example.traditional: 我哋婚後嘅生活一直都好平淡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 fan1 hau6 ge3 sang1 wut6 jat1 zik6 dou1 hou2 ping4 daam6

rows.note: Use this when ordinary means normal or as expected rather than merely unremarkable.

example.english: Everything is ordinary, so there’s no need to worry.
example.jyutping: jat1 cai3 zing3 soeng4 m4 sai2 daam1 sam1
